scenario.instruction: Make an appointment for Margaret Thompson with Dr Shera today after 2 pm but before 3:45.

fixture_map.staff: synthetic Receptionist using the configured pilot allowlist identity
fixture_map.roster: Room 1 assigned to Dr Alex Shera on D

harness.authentication: synthetic receptionist logs in through POST /api/v1/auth/login on a loopback same-origin bootstrap page; the bootstrap stores the returned token without recording or inspecting it and navigates to the real Diary
flow: create the exact locked disposable database and schema without a migration
seed only the frozen synthetic fixture map
prove database identity, synthetic-only table inventory, roster, availability, fake provider, pilot allowlist and zero baseline command counts before opening the browser
start one loopback FastAPI process bound to the isolated database
start one loopback static server for the real docs/ Diary and the authentication bootstrap
open the authenticated real Diary on D with bernie_open=true and bernie_review=live and without smoke=true
capture sanitized request method/path/status evidence without headers, credentials, tokens or secret-bearing traces
execute S1-S7 and keep fixture setup counts separate from product-command counts

direct_fake_provider_supporting_smoke.explanation: The service-only smoke does not have database identity context and therefore cannot resolve the practitioner or patient names. The unchanged authenticated API route performs same-practice name resolution before recomputing the interpretation, so this supporting-only result is not a reproduced Stage 1 product defect.

pre_browser_stop_checks: database name and connection target differ from every shared database
schema was created without a migration and all admitted rows match the frozen synthetic fixture inventory
appointments, appointment audit and appointment command idempotency baseline counts are zero
the configured receptionist authenticates in the synthetic practice and passes pilot eligibility
Dr Alex Shera is rostered on D and 14:00-15:45 is available
effective interpreter provider is fake and live provider is disabled
no cloud/provider/ADC/gcloud/ngrok environment or outbound route is enabled
the browser URL is loopback, omits smoke=true and uses no request interception
